claims.claim: From tax year 2025 the Economic Efficiency Law published on 26 December 2024 adds a further 2% surtax, on top of the tax fixed in Section 121B(a), on taxable income from capital sources above the amount fixed in that section. Section 121B(a) itself charges 3% above 721,560 NIS. No such capital-source addition existed for 2020-2024.

על הכנסה חייבת ממקורות הוניים העולה על הסכום הקבוע בסעיף.
